 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Combine the binary patterns above and below the all-4 separator."""
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top = grid[:split]
    bottom = grid[split + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("pattern halves must have equal height")
    return [[3 if top[r][c] != 0 or bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[r]))]
            for r in range(len(top))]

if __name__ == "__main__":
